shots.beat: The ancient settlement at golden hour: a valley built around a ring of stone.

setup.eval: (()=>{const g=__game; g.player.place(1.35,0,38.0,Math.PI); TR.place('tala',-0.6,0,33.2,Math.PI); TR.walk('tala',[[-0.7,12],[-0.6,-2]],1.3); g.input.setStick(0,0.36,0.36); return 'kai and tala walking to the ring'})()

shots.characters: Kai walking away from the lens toward the Old Ring (a calm 1.5 m/s walk, analog stick), Tala walking beside him on the left, villagers on the plaza around the Ring
shots.lighting: The mission's golden-hour sun low behind the Ring (frame left), warm valley haze; no rig light, Kai's back stays in the house shadow.
shots.sound: Wind and water bed; the switch transition lands on the cut.
shots.notes: Telephoto (24 to 23 deg) walk-away between two houses that frame the Ring: the camera cranes up 0.65 m and creeps in while Kai walks away from it, so he shrinks into the valley and the Ring rises clear above him. Focus follows Kai the whole way (a rack to the Ring sharpened the mission's faceted cliff backdrop into crumpled-paper facets; held on Kai the cliffs stay a soft painted wall and the Ring a glowing halo). The tree on the lens line (-0.5, 30.1) is hidden for the whole shot.

preview.note: Golden hour, villagers, the stone ring; faceted low-poly trees (known mission 4 item).

shots.beat: Niko, keeper of the Telling, reads the ring on Kai's wrist: "You came before the first fire."

setup.eval: (()=>{const g=__game,k=g.player.char,n=g.actors.niko; n.root.position.set(2.5,0.6,-6.2); n.root.rotation.y=0.477; g.player.place(3.37,0.3,-4.51,-2.664); g.input.setStick(0,0,0); n.lookTarget=k.head; k.lookTarget=n.head; TR.clip('kai','talk',0.3,0.7); return 'niko faces kai in front of the Ring'})()

shots.characters: Niko (medium close-up, talking to Kai: the VO line), Kai (soft foreground head and shoulder, frame left; his steady 'talk' clip at 0.7x so his head does not wander like the idle does)
shots.lighting: Niko stands between the lens and the Old Ring: the low sun behind the Ring rims him, the dialogue rig keys his face, and the Ring's glowing inner rim makes a halo around him; the halo fragments sweep behind.
shots.notes: Long-lens over-the-shoulder (19.5 to 18.5 deg) with a slow 0.4 m push, the lens just under Niko's eye line and his eyes on the upper third of the 2.39 band. Niko on the platform at (2.5, 0.6, -6.2) faces Kai (3.37, 0.3, -4.51); the camera sits on the far side of the Niko-Ring line so the Ring frames him. Niko talks from 0.92 s (the VO 'You came before the first fire.'), Kai answers from 2.62 s ('I've never been here.').

preview.note: Niko medium close-up framed by the village Ring.

shots.beat: One valley, two ages: the thriving village switches to Helix's drowned Reservoir 7.

setup.eval: (()=>{const g=__game; g.player.place(2,0,12,0); TR.hide('kai'); TR.hide('niko'); const f=g.scene.fog; f.color.set(0xd6ae84); f.density=0.0065; g.engine.aoPass.comp.uniforms.uFade.value.set(24,44); return 'shadows centred on the village, golden haze, AO faded before the hills'})()

shots.characters: Villagers round the plaza fire and in the lanes (thriving); nobody in 2049, dead trees standing in the water. Kai and Niko are hidden (Kai parked at (2, 0, 12) so the sun's shadow map covers the village).
shots.lighting: Thriving: the mission's low south-east sun straight into the lens through a warm golden haze (fog d6ae84, 0.0065, set at run time; the mission's own fog is a cool a9c1dd), bloom streak off the channel. Flooded: the mission's own 2049 day sky and fog (its applySky resets the haze on the switch), cold and flat.
shots.sound: Switch stinger, then the causal-consequence resonance under the dam hum.
shots.notes: A slow crane down and in from the north end of the valley (10.4 to 8.4 m, 5 m forward, 44 to 43 deg) over the rooftops toward the plaza fire, the waterwheel on the channel at left and the Water Ring on the retaining wall at right. At 2.6 s DIR.era switches to the flooded state: the same Water Ring stands on the same wall over the survey buoy, dead trees in the water, the outlet tower and the dam across the valley. GTAO fades out at 24-44 m (uFade) because the engine's GTAO bands the distant hillsides into horizontal stripes.

preview.note: Golden village with the plaza fire and the Water Ring switches to the cold reservoir: same wall, same ring, the buoy, dead trees, the tower and the dam.

shots.beat: The Sky House: the bronze Sun Gate at dawn c. 1000 BCE, keepers below it, switches to Helix's 2049 night: the same gate dark under the stars, the drum under its glowing survey canopy.

setup.eval: (()=>{const g=__game, m=window.__m7, W=m.W; m.sunGate.set(62, 6, false); W.setBeam(true); W.sunBeam.visible = true; const s=g.actors.sefa; if (s) s.lookTarget = new TR.V(40, 9, 12); return 'sun gate aimed at the sunrise (062, 6), weight-beam lowered as the bridge, sunbeam on'})()

shots.characters: Dawn: Sefa, the old Sky Keeper, beside the Sun Gate, an acolyte with a staff at the left post and a woman with a water jar on the East Terrace. 2049: nobody.
shots.lighting: Dawn: the mission's low ENE sun from behind the camera's right glints on the bronze rings; the gate is aimed at the sunrise (Instrument.set(62, 6)) and its sunbeam shaft crosses the terrace toward the sun stone. 2049: the mission's night (starfield, the survey canopy glowing over the drum, a floodlight at right), exposure lifted to 2.0 at the swap (the mission sets 1.25) so the night reads under the dawn's locked eye adaptation.
shots.sound: Night: glass tones under Mira's recorded voice.
shots.notes: Replaces the storyboard's high view over the drum (the dawn sky rendered flat grey from up there). From just off the East Terrace the camera pushes in 2.3 m and settles 0.5 m (40 to 38.5 deg) on the aligned Sun Gate; its weight-beam, lowered as the bridge to the first roof (as after the alignment), leads the eye to the drum. DIR.era('2049', 0.9) at 1.55 s swaps at 2.0 s, so the dawn plays under "It doesn't record you, Kai." and the night under "It's been waiting for you." (1.1 s of clean night before the cut-out). Staging is run-time only (the gate's own set(), W.setBeam, W.sunBeam).

preview.note: Sun Gate at dawn with Sefa and the keepers; the same gate under the 2049 stars with the canopy over the drum.

shots.beat: Montage: dusk on the ruined summit, 2196; the scavenger chief Dace by the Wandering Ring, his rewind gauntlet charging green.

setup.eval: __game.temporal.setImmediate('2196'); 'era 2196, Kai stays at the foot of the steps (placing him up here would start the Sefa scene)'

actions.eval: (()=>{const d=window.__m7.scavs.find(s=>s.id==='dace'); d.t=1.0; return 'hold the charge (no shot inside the handles)'})()

shots.characters: Dace (2196 scavenger boss, respirator hood) in the game's own aim state: the 'look' stance with the gauntlet raised to his chest, its glow charging from 3 to 9 (the Scav aim curve); a lookout behind him on the rim. Kai stays at the foot of the steps (out of shot) so the mission does not start the Sefa scene.
shots.lighting: The 2196 sunset sky behind Dace (west), clouds lit pink, the green gauntlet glow keys his coat; the sun's shadow map is pinned to the summit (the mission centres it on Kai).
shots.notes: Low medium-wide from the east rim (30 to 29 deg, a 0.6 m linear creep in, light hand-held), focus on Dace, the armillary of the Wandering Ring frame right. Dace is turned to face the lens (faceTowards disabled, rotation 1.75) and set active in the aim state at t = -0.3, so the charge builds through the cut and would fire at 1.6 s; actions at 1.55 / 1.8 s hold it at t = 1.0 so no shot leaves inside the tail handle. His 'look' aim stance is started at 0.1 s at 0.6x (TR.clip): later in that clip he turns his back to the lens. Stills: stills/s25_lookdev (rendered by the look-dev page, same setup and actions).

preview.note: Dace in his aim stance, the gauntlet glowing, the Wandering Ring and the dusk sky.

shots.beat: Montage: Reservoir 7, dead trees standing in the water over a village that never existed.
shots.characters: Nobody: Kai and Niko are hidden; a drowned dead tree stands in the foreground.
shots.lighting: The mission's flat 2049 day light on the reservoir, haze on the hills; the sun's shadow map is pinned over the water (the mission centres it on Kai).
shots.notes: Low over the water, 1 m above the surface (40 deg), a 1 m linear truck right so the dead tree at (2, 8) slides against the far shore: the outlet tower G-2 on the left third, the dam across the valley, the drowned tree on the right third. GTAO fades out at 24-44 m (the engine's GTAO bands the distant hillsides). Stills: stills/s31_lookdev (rendered by the look-dev page, same setup).

preview.note: Dead tree in the water, the outlet tower and the dam beyond.
